why.title: Why work with us
why.sub: Four things a hardware buyer actually checks before ordering.

items.d: 128-layer TLC NAND with an industrial-focused controller — checked against its datasheet before it ships.
Distribution-level pricing for bulk and repeat orders, quoted transparently — no hidden markup.
Consistent stock and lead times, communicated clearly so you can plan procurement.
Direct access to people who can answer interface, capacity, and compatibility questions.

products.title: Product line
products.sub: Starting with SSDs across four form factors. Built to expand into RAM, GPUs, CPUs, motherboards, and networking hardware.

items.name: GTD M.2 NVMe PCIe
items.perf: up to 7400 MB/s read / 6500 MB/s write

products.ramNote: Also sourcing: DDR3 / DDR4 / DDR5 U-DIMM and SO-DIMM memory — 2GB–32GB, 1333–6000MHz.

quality.title: Quality and verification
quality.sub: Every unit is functionally tested before it ships, and a benchmark report is kept on file per batch.

items.d: Manufacturer certified to ISO 9001 (quality management), CE, and FCC standards.
Incoming inspection and functional testing on every batch using CrystalDiskMark, AS SSD Benchmark, CrystalDiskInfo, HD Tune Pro, ATTO, and burn-in testing.
Near interface-max sequential speeds, ~800TB endurance (TBW), and a 1.5M-hour MTBF rating.
S.M.A.R.T. health monitoring and TRIM enabled on every unit, with traceable batch records from supplier to shipment.
Fleet upgrades and standardized hardware procurement.
Reliable stock for client deployments and repairs.
Volume orders with consistent lead times.
